a11y_page.meta.title: Accessibility Statement | Kuvshinov Software
a11y_page.meta.desc: Learn about our commitment to providing accessibility at Kuvshinov Software.
a11y_page.title: Accessibility Statement
a11y_page.sec1.title: 1. General Principles and Commitment
a11y_page.sec1.p1: Valeriy Kuvshinov, doing business as Kuvshinov Software ("Company", "We", or "Us"), operates as an independent digital consultancy and development agency. Because we provide professional accessibility remediation services, we hold our own digital infrastructure to the highest standards of digital inclusivity. We act to the full extent of our technical capabilities to ensure our platform provides an equal, seamless experience for all web users, including individuals with visual, motor, or cognitive disabilities.
a11y_page.sec1.p2: This statement applies strictly to the digital properties operating under the domain root at <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>kuvware.com<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/>. As a fully distributed digital entity, the Company operates no physical commercial offices open to the public; consequently, physical access metrics are non-applicable to our operational scope.
a11y_page.sec2.title: 2. Digital Accessibility Standards & "No Overlay" Policy
a11y_page.sec2.p1: The digital structure of this website has been engineered from the ground up—using native, semantic code—to achieve functional alignment with the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C) Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at Level AA and AAA conformance.
a11y_page.sec2.p2: We strictly oppose the use of automated "accessibility overlays" or temporary widget patches. Instead, inclusivity is built directly into the DOM, ensuring structural interoperability with native assistive technologies, including screen readers, refreshable braille displays, and alternative input hardware.
a11y_page.sec3.title: 3. Implemented Accessibility Controls
a11y_page.sec3.desc: The core website architecture utilizes standard programmatic modifications alongside an integrated native accessibility menu, allowing users to execute real-time structural adaptations:
a11y_page.sec3.li1: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Semantic Document Geometry:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Strict hierarchical heading order (H1 — H6), correct ARIA 1.2 labeling, and semantic landmark segmentation (<x id="START_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="<code>"/><main><x id="CLOSE_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="</code>"/>, <x id="START_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="<code>"/><nav><x id="CLOSE_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="</code>"/>, <x id="START_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="<code>"/><aside><x id="CLOSE_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="</code>"/>) to facilitate fast screen reader index navigation.
a11y_page.sec3.li2: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Native Keyboard Navigation Protocol:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Complete operational execution via standard keyboard loops, including custom focus traps on modals and highly visible focus indicators.
a11y_page.sec3.li3: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Skip Link Overrides:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Accessible skip links placed at the absolute programmatic root level, allowing keyboard users to bypass layout directly to the main content or footer.
a11y_page.sec3.li4: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Color Contrast Optimization:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Visual text layers and active interactive components maintain an enhanced luminance contrast ratio matching or exceeding strict AAA (7:1) thresholds.
a11y_page.sec3.li5: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Advanced Typography Toggles:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> An isolated native accessibility interface allowing user-driven configuration changes, including system sans-serif overrides for dyslexia assistance, progressive scaling for text size, line-height modifications, and letter-spacing vectors.
a11y_page.sec3.li6: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Motion Mutation Flags:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Comprehensive system hooks to pause looping animations and CSS transition matrices, synchronized automatically with system-level hardware preferences (<x id="START_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="<code>"/>prefers-reduced-motion<x id="CLOSE_TAG_CODE" ctype="x-code" equiv-text="</code>"/>).
a11y_page.sec4.title: 4. Programmatic Boundaries & Third-Party Platforms
a11y_page.sec4.desc: Users navigating our digital infrastructure may encounter specific structural boundaries dictated by external runtime layers and third-party ecosystems:
a11y_page.sec4.li1: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Security Challenges (CAPTCHA):<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> To protect against automated abuse, we utilize Cloudflare Turnstile. While Turnstile is designed to run invisibly and provide accessible fallbacks, strict browser privacy settings may occasionally force a visual challenge.
a11y_page.sec4.li2: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>External Platform Redirection:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> This website contains active links routing out to external ecosystems (including LinkedIn, GitHub, and client portfolio sites). These properties are maintained exclusively by their respective corporations or owners; consequently, their accessibility conformance levels remain entirely beyond our control.
a11y_page.sec5.title: 5. Remediation, Feedback, and Contact Details
a11y_page.sec5.link_aria: here. Go to the Contact page
a11y_page.sec5.p2: As part of our commitment to accessible engineering, we evaluate all accessibility inquiries rapidly and process structural modifications with the highest technical priority.
a11y_page.sec5.p3: This statement is legally effective as of October 3, 2026.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, and protection of data by Valeriy Kuvshinov, doing business as Kuvshinov Software ("Company", "We", or "Us"), across our digital platform (kuvware.com) and associated applications, including the "Did Not Get It" browser extension (collectively, "the Services").
privacy.sec1.title: 1. Direct Communication & Contact Form
privacy.sec1.p1: When you voluntarily submit a query via the platform's official Contact Form, we collect your provided name, email address, and the contents of your message. This constitutes Personal Identifiable Information (PII).
privacy.sec1.p2: This data is collected for the sole, explicit purpose of customer service, technical support, and responding to your inquiry. The data is transmitted securely to our administrative inbox. We explicitly guarantee that your communication data is <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>never<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> sold, rented, or transferred to third-party marketing entities. Correspondence is retained for operational continuity unless you formally request its deletion.
privacy.sec2.title: 2. Telemetry, Analytics, and Infrastructure Logging
privacy.sec2.p1: To maintain operational stability and optimize the user experience, the website utilizes third-party analytics infrastructure, specifically Google Analytics. Subject to explicit consent granted via the platform's Cookie Banner, these services deploy standard tracking technologies ("Cookies") to aggregate non-identifiable usage metrics.
privacy.sec2.p2: Aggregated data sets may include masked IP addresses, browser specifications, and structural navigation patterns. This data cannot be reverse-engineered to personally identify you. You retain the right to revoke consent unilaterally at any time by declining via the Cookie Banner or purging local browser storage and cookie caches pertaining to this domain.
privacy.sec2.p3: In addition to third-party analytics, our core web server infrastructure temporarily logs standard transmission metrics—including IP addresses, user-agent strings, and request timestamps—solely for the purposes of security auditing, DDoS mitigation, and ensuring the technical stability of the Services. These infrastructure logs are routinely rotated and destroyed, and are never used for marketing or individual user profiling.
privacy.sec3.title: 3. Security and Bot Protection
privacy.sec3.link_aria: Cloudflare Turnstile Privacy Addendum (opens in a new tab)
privacy.sec4.title: 4. Remote Digital Assistance & Consulting Services
privacy.sec4.p1: During the provision of Remote Digital Assistance—such as guided form completion, navigational support, or CAPTCHA bypassing—we may transiently encounter highly sensitive personal, medical, or financial information (including credit card details or credentials).
privacy.sec4.p2: We enforce a strict <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>zero-retention policy<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> for all live-session data. We do not record, log, store, cache, or transmit any sensitive user data encountered during these sessions. All assistance is provided ephemerally, and no persistent record of your private credentials or financial information is ever created or maintained by the Company.
privacy.sec5.title: 5. "Did Not Get It" Extension: Data Minimization
privacy.sec5.intro: The "Did Not Get It" browser extension operates entirely locally within your browser. Our core principle is absolute data minimization: your data belongs to you, stays on your device, and is never transmitted to our servers.
privacy.sec5.li1: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>No Telemetry or Tracking:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> We do not track your browsing behavior, clicks, or extension usage.
privacy.sec5.li2: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>No Server Transmissions:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> We do not own, operate, or route your data through any external backend servers.
privacy.sec5.li3: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>No Email Harvesting:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> Your email content, sender addresses, and metadata are never copied, logged, or sent to the developer or any third party.
privacy.sec6.title: 6. Extension: Google API Data Access (Limited Use)
privacy.sec6.intro: In order to function, the Extension requests access to your Gmail account using the Google OAuth 2.0 protocol. We access and use this data in the following strictly limited ways:
privacy.sec6.li1: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Reading Data:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> The Extension reads the HTML text of incoming unread emails locally in your browser to check for standard job rejection phrasing.
privacy.sec6.li2: <x id="START_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="<strong>"/>Modifying Data:<x id="CLOSE_TAG_STRONG" ctype="x-strong" equiv-text="</strong>"/> If a rejection is detected, the Extension communicates directly with the Google Gmail API to apply your custom label and remove the "UNREAD" status from that specific thread.
privacy.sec6.link_aria: Google API Services User Data Policy (opens in a new tab)
privacy.sec7.title: 7. External Routing and Liability
privacy.sec7.p1: The Services may contain routing nodes and hyperlinks directing traffic to external digital ecosystems. Upon executing a redirection to an external domain, you are immediately subject to the privacy architecture of that third party. We exercise no administrative control over external properties and explicitly disclaim all liability for their data handling practices.
privacy.sec8.title: 8. Data Inquiry and Contact Details
privacy.sec8.link_aria: here. Go to the Contact page
privacy.sec8.p2: This policy is legally effective as of October 22, 2026.
